preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of edges must be exactly N-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All endpoints of the edges must be valid node numbers between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of connected components obtained after performing the operations.
